csv_scope_of_work: This project aims to improve the accessibility of existing pedestrian infrastructure in the Village of Scotia and includes the completion of a Self-Evaluation and Transition Plan in a format that may be adopted by the Village. Recognizing that the United States Access Board adopted the Public Right of Way Accessibility Guidelines (PROWAG) in 2023, the Village of Scotia Self-Evaluation and Transition Plan will follow the PROWAG.
